Information You need to get about Bio-Links.

 Always Wondering about how to let the WORLD know about yourself, achievements, and skills, but unable to find the way out! Now the wait is over as Replug has Introduced a New Feature of "Bio Links" for its valuable customers.   

Bio Links are used to creating a link or portfolio; displaying Information about a person, website, or organization.

Excited to Know more and use this new Feature? So let's get started:

Note: We have three kinds of Widgets for Bio Links 1: Social Icons 2: Links 3: RSS Feeds from these only one is compulsory for creating your Bio Links.

Step 1

Login or Signup to your Replug.io account. Click on the Bio Links in the header and Bio Links Page Will Appear on the Screen.
Click on the New Bio-Link Button on the top left of the screen. it will take you to the Add Content Page.

Note: In the following steps, we will give you a walk-through of all three widgets. You can add them Multiple times Also.

Step 2

Click on Social icons and select the Social media platforms on which you want to share your profile/content and Click on Next Button. 

Note: You can Select only 5 Social Media Platforms at a time.

Step 3

Page with the title "Add Social Media Platforms" will appear. Toggle against "Show Title" is enabled By Default but can be disabled if you don't want to Add a title.   

Click on Add Block Button after You are done with entering data in the input fields. You can also Get the Mobile preview in the right corner of the screen.

Step 4

You will be redirected to Add Content page, displaying the Social Media Platforms and Title (If added) in addition to the Icons for Add A New Block.

 Click on the Links icon under ADD A NEW BLOCK.
